description: This file provides a JavaScript implementation of the SHA-1 cryptographic hash algorithm, including functions for computing SHA-1 hashes, HMACs, and encoding conversions. It includes utility functions for text encoding, hash calculation, and self-testing.

methods.name: hex_sha1(s)
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of a string and encodes it in hexadecimal.

methods.name: b64_sha1(s)
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash and encodes it in base64.

methods.name: any_sha1(s, e)
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash and encodes it in an arbitrary encoding.

methods.name: hex_hmac_sha1(k, d)
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, output in hex.

methods.name: b64_hmac_sha1(k, d)
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, output in base64.

methods.name: any_hmac_sha1(k, d, e)
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, output in an arbitrary encoding.

methods.name: sha1_vm_test()
methods.description: Performs a self-test to verify SHA-1 implementation correctness.

methods.name: rstr_sha1(s)
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of a raw string, returning raw string output.

methods.name: rstr_hmac_sha1(key, data)
methods.description: Calculates HMAC-SHA1 of a key and data, both raw strings.

methods.name: rstr2hex(input)
methods.description: Converts a raw string to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: rstr2b64(input)
methods.description: Converts a raw string to a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: rstr2any(input, encoding)
methods.description: Converts a raw string to an arbitrary encoding provided as input.

methods.name: str2rstr_utf8(input)
methods.description: Encodes a UTF-16 string into UTF-8 byte sequence.

methods.name: rstr2binb(input)
methods.description: Converts a raw string into an array of big-endian words.

methods.name: binb2rstr(input)
methods.description: Converts an array of big-endian words into a raw string.

methods.name: binb_sha1(x, len)
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of an array of big-endian words with a specified length.

methods.name: sha1_ft(t, b, c, d)
methods.description: SHA-1 auxiliary function for each iteration of the main loop.

methods.name: sha1_kt(t)
methods.description: SHA-1 constant for each iteration of the main loop.

methods.name: safe_add(x, y)
methods.description: Adds two 32-bit integers, wrapping at 2^32.

methods.name: bit_rol(num, cnt)
methods.description: Performs a left bitwise rotation on a 32-bit number.

methods.name: str2rstr_utf16be(input)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: str2rstr_utf16le(input)
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: b64pad
ctags.pattern: /^var b64pad  = ""; \/* base-64 pad character. "=" for strict RFC compliance   *\/$/

ctags.name: hexcase
ctags.pattern: /^var hexcase = 0;  \/* hex output format. 0 - lowercase; 1 - uppercase        *\/$/

fields.name: var b64pad  = ""; \/* base-64 pad character. "=" for strict RFC compliance   *\/
var hexcase = 0;  \/* hex output format. 0 - lowercase; 1 - uppercase        *\/
